SELECT FROM reviews r JOIN plans p ON p.id = r.plan_id WHERE r.plan_id = #{planId} AND ORDER BY r.period_start DESC, r.created_at DESC, r.id ASC

mapper.sql: WITH scope_todos AS ( SELECT t.id, t.title, t.status, t.due_date, t.priority, t.estimated_minutes, t.created_at, () AS is_completed, () AS is_overdue FROM todos t JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE t.plan_id = #{planId} AND ), scope_logs AS ( SELECT e.todo_id, SUM(e.actual_minutes) AS actual_minutes, BOOL_OR() AS has_blocker FROM execution_logs e JOIN scope_todos st ON st.id = e.todo_id GROUP BY e.todo_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(t.id) AS planned_count, COUNT(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.is_completed) AS completed_count, COUNT(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.is_overdue) AS overdue_count, COUNT(t.id) FILTER (WHERE l.has_blocker) AS blocked_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.estimated_minutes), 0) AS estimated_minutes, COALESCE(SUM(l.actual_minutes), 0) AS actual_minutes, COALESCE(SUM(l.actual_minutes), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(t.estimated_minutes), 0) AS variance_minutes FROM scope_todos t LEFT JOIN scope_logs l ON l.todo_id = t.id

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.status, t.due_date, t.priority, t.estimated_minutes, COALESCE(l.actual_minutes, 0) AS actual_minutes, COALESCE(l.has_blocker, FALSE) AS blocked FROM scope_todos t LEFT JOIN scope_logs l ON l.todo_id = t.id
WHERE t.is_completed
WHERE t.is_overdue
WHERE l.has_blocker
